name: build-and-deploy-multi-service
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  build-api:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      image_digest: ${{ steps.push.outputs.digest }}
    steps:
      - id: push
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          push: true
          tags: ghcr.io/acme/api:latest
  build-worker:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      image_digest: ${{ steps.push2.outputs.digest }}
    steps:
      - id: push2
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          push: true
          tags: ghcr.io/acme/worker:latest
  deploy-api:
    needs: build-api
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: terraform apply -auto-approve -var="image=ghcr.io/acme/api@${{ needs.build-api.outputs.image_digest }}"
        working-directory: infra/api
  deploy-worker:
    needs: build-worker
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: terraform apply -auto-approve -var="image=ghcr.io/acme/worker@${{ needs.build-worker.outputs.image_digest }}"
        working-directory: infra/worker

name: build-and-deploy
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      image_digest: ${{ steps.push.outputs.digest }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      - id: push
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          push: true
          tags: ghcr.io/acme/api:latest

  deploy:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v3
      - run: terraform init
        working-directory: infra
      - run: terraform apply -auto-approve -var="image=ghcr.io/acme/api@${{ needs.build.outputs.image_digest }}"
        working-directory: infra
